subject: english
question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom “To draw the long bow”.

options.text: To tell an unbelievable or exaggerated story

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. To tell an unbelievable or exaggerated story.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"To draw the long bow"** means to tell an exaggerated or unbelievable story, often stretching the truth.
